```{r}
df <- mtcars
library(ggplot2)
theme_light <- thematic::thematic_theme(bg = "white", fg = "black", accent = "cornflowerblue")
theme_dark <- thematic::thematic_theme(bg = "black", fg = "white", accent = "cornflowerblue")
```
Testing
```{r}
#| label: sampleGraph
#| fig.alt: "A line graph showing the population data"
#| renderings: [light, dark]
p <- df |> ggplot(aes(x=mpg,y=wt))+
  geom_point()
thematic::thematic_set_theme(theme_light)
plotly::ggplotly(p)
thematic::thematic_set_theme(theme_dark)
plotly::ggplotly(p)
```
